title: Declining to promise the reeve and then choosing 'leave the barrow open to the sky' at the throne logs 'Quest failed: The Barrow Doors' in the journal, even though both the reeve ('I'll hold nothing against you') and the priest ('no promise binds them shut') explicitly say the choice is free of consequence. Reading it as a failure is misleading.
where: Throne of the Barrow / Empty Seat - seal or leave open choice
